### Bug or Regression?

Bug

### Description

cursor:zoom_factor is ignored unless the cursor is hidden.

### How to reproduce

```bash
hyprctl keyword cursor:zoom_factor 2
```

comments: Same here. cursor:zoom_factor breaks as soon as i move my cursor.

is this a regression?
if so please bisect
It is a regression. But I can't pinpoint the exact commit that caused it. Before 19186de setting the zoom level crashes Hyprland, and after that it no longer crashes but has this issue.

> It is a regression. But I can't pinpoint the exact commit that caused it. Before [19186de](https://github.com/hyprwm/Hyprland/commit/19186de11834df43494378478d2d3a374e2409ae) setting the zoom level crashes Hyprland, and after that it no longer crashes but has this issue.

after which commit does it start crashing?

After some digging I half solved the problem ([patch.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/15709920/patch.txt)), but now there's another one
![rip_cursors](https://github.com/hyprwm/Hyprland/assets/73481042/74dcd0b4-4810-4aeb-9018-39172248d5fd)

Seems to me like hardware cursors are still being rendered even though they should be disabled.
I know line 368 is being run cause logs, and docs say it should disable hardware cursor... but it doesn't
https://github.com/hyprwm/Hyprland/blob/af5f24929d83cc7a97a77de516bc665e38acfa12/src/managers/PointerManager.cpp#L362-L372

Im stuck there but I'll leave this here if anyone else wants to give it a shot
